kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: OpenAI expands its Daybreak program with the full version of GPT-5.5-Cyber, a Codex Security plugin to find, validate and fix vulnerabilities, a Patch the Planet effort to move open-source maintainers from findings to merged fixes, and a Cyber Partner Program.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official OpenAI product launch; primary source corroborated by sama and gdb.

kept_items.author: IntCyberDigest
kept_items.text: Analytical reframe of the OpenAI cyber launch: the model beats Mythos on the CyberGym bug-finding benchmark, applied to the permissive exploit-capable model given to verified defenders.
kept_items.selection_reason: Distinct third-party analysis with benchmark detail and dual-use framing.

kept_items.author: GoogleDeepMind
kept_items.text: Google DeepMind announces a research partnership with film studio A24 to build AI tools for movie production and distribution; reporting puts the figure at $75M.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official DeepMind corporate move; $75M figure from WSJ via DiscussingFilm.

kept_items.author: xiaohu
kept_items.text: ByteDance releases upgraded Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 video models with 30-second single-pass clips, native 4K, up to 50 full-modal reference inputs and 3D white-model support, plus a new AI copyright commercialization platform.
kept_items.selection_reason: Most detailed primary report of Seedance 2.0/2.5; corroborated by testingcatalog and LinusEkenstam.

kept_items.author: DataChaz
kept_items.text: Santander's AI Lab open-sources 11 repositories under the Apache-2.0 license, releasing internal AI infrastructure for public use.
kept_items.selection_reason: Notable open-source release from a major bank; concrete and distinct from frontier-lab news.

kept_items.author: Vivek4real_
kept_items.text: Sam Altman is shown ChatGPT producing fabricated answers during a live on-stage demo; when repeated the model invents another reply, and when shown Altman's own comment the model states he was wrong.
kept_items.selection_reason: Widely circulated on-stage event; detail corroborated by FutureWinsDaily.

kept_items.author: Steve8708
kept_items.text: Steve8708 launches Clips, a free open-source agent-native alternative to Loom; agents can parse a Clip directly from a URL through its APIs and metadata and can see and hear its contents.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-source product launch with an agent-native design angle.

kept_items.author: dair_ai
kept_items.text: A large LLM-as-a-Judge reliability audit runs 21 judges from nine providers across roughly 541,000 judgments on MT-Bench, JudgeBench and RewardBench, finding that exact-match agreement overstates a judge's true skill.
kept_items.selection_reason: Substantive research summary with concrete scale and a useful methodological finding.

kept_items.author: nathanrs
kept_items.text: A developer turns Apple Notes into a Claude/ChatGPT frontend, letting any LLM API be used to chat directly inside the Notes interface.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete, low-noise practitioner build repurposing Apple Notes as an LLM client.

kept_items.author: iamlukethedev
kept_items.text: A developer reports asking the Hermes agent to install Computer Use, remotely control a machine, take a screenshot and return it, with the setup completing without manual configuration.
kept_items.selection_reason: Fresh hands-on agent computer-use account with a concrete workflow.

kept_items.author: AlexFinn
kept_items.text: A widely shared post reports Mac Studio units selling out except the 96GB configuration, framing the demand as a signal of growing interest in running AI models locally.
kept_items.selection_reason: Local-AI demand signal with solid engagement; distinct hardware angle.
